title: CORS reflects arbitrary origin with credentials
impact: A malicious website may be able to read responses from this application in a victim browser.
remediation: Validate Origin against a strict allow-list; never reflect arbitrary origins with credentials.

title: Exposed Git repository metadata
impact: Sensitive configuration, source code or data may be disclosed to unauthenticated users, enabling follow-on attacks.
remediation: Remove the file from the web root, deny access in the web-server configuration and rotate any credentials it contained.

title: Exposed environment file (.env)
impact: Sensitive configuration, source code or data may be disclosed to unauthenticated users, enabling follow-on attacks.
remediation: Remove the file from the web root, deny access in the web-server configuration and rotate any credentials it contained.

title: Cookie without HttpOnly attribute
impact: Session cookies may be exposed to script access or sent over insecure channels, increasing the risk of session theft.
remediation: Set the HttpOnly attribute on cookies that JavaScript does not need.

title: Directory listing enabled
impact: Technical details help attackers choose and tune attacks against the system.
remediation: Disable directory indexing (Options -Indexes, autoindex off) and review exposed files.

title: Site served only over unencrypted HTTP
impact: Traffic may be intercepted or modified in transit, exposing credentials and user data.
remediation: Deploy a valid TLS certificate, enable HTTPS and redirect HTTP to HTTPS.

title: phpinfo() page exposed
impact: Sensitive configuration, source code or data may be disclosed to unauthenticated users, enabling follow-on attacks.
remediation: Remove the file from the web root, deny access in the web-server configuration and rotate any credentials it contained.

title: Cookie without SameSite attribute
impact: Session cookies may be exposed to script access or sent over insecure channels, increasing the risk of session theft.
remediation: Set SameSite=Lax or Strict (None only with Secure when required).

title: HTTP TRACE method enabled
impact: Weak configuration may expose unnecessary functionality or information.
remediation: Disable TRACE (e.g. TraceEnable off).

title: Missing Content-Security-Policy header
impact: Browsers are not instructed to apply defence-in-depth protections, which makes exploitation of other flaws (XSS, clickjacking, downgrade attacks) easier.
remediation: Define a restrictive Content-Security-Policy (avoid unsafe-inline/unsafe-eval).

title: Missing X-Content-Type-Options header
impact: Browsers are not instructed to apply defence-in-depth protections, which makes exploitation of other flaws (XSS, clickjacking, downgrade attacks) easier.
remediation: Send X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff on all responses.

title: Missing clickjacking protection (X-Frame-Options / frame-ancestors)
impact: Browsers are not instructed to apply defence-in-depth protections, which makes exploitation of other flaws (XSS, clickjacking, downgrade attacks) easier.
remediation: Send X-Frame-Options: DENY (or SAMEORIGIN) or a CSP frame-ancestors directive.

title: Potentially dangerous HTTP methods advertised
impact: Weak configuration may expose unnecessary functionality or information.
remediation: Disable unused HTTP methods and require authentication for write methods.

title: Version information disclosed in server header
impact: Technical details help attackers choose and tune attacks against the system.
remediation: Remove or genericise version banners (e.g. ServerTokens Prod, server_tokens off, expose_php=Off).

title: Version information disclosed in x-powered-by header
impact: Technical details help attackers choose and tune attacks against the system.
remediation: Remove or genericise version banners (e.g. ServerTokens Prod, server_tokens off, expose_php=Off).

title: robots.txt references sensitive-looking paths
impact: Technical details help attackers choose and tune attacks against the system.
remediation: Do not rely on robots.txt to hide content; protect sensitive paths with authentication and remove revealing entries.

title: Missing Permissions-Policy header
impact: Browsers are not instructed to apply defence-in-depth protections, which makes exploitation of other flaws (XSS, clickjacking, downgrade attacks) easier.
remediation: Send a Permissions-Policy header disabling unused features.

title: Missing Referrer-Policy header
impact: Browsers are not instructed to apply defence-in-depth protections, which makes exploitation of other flaws (XSS, clickjacking, downgrade attacks) easier.
remediation: Send Referrer-Policy: strict-origin-when-cross-origin or stricter.

title: Web service identified
impact: No direct security impact; the observation provides context for the assessment.
remediation: No action required.

title: sitemap.xml is publicly accessible
impact: No direct security impact; the observation provides context for the assessment.
remediation: No action required unless the sitemap exposes non-public URLs.
